name: 094 — The widget and the thing
author: brodgar
description: Self-checking suite for the whole of feature 094: the crossing back from the domain objects into the widget tree (:widget() on Buff, Meter, StudySlot and Kin), the four facts a widget could not say about itself (:session(), :events(), :owned(), :is(sel)), the wound tree walking downward, gob:party(), store():list(), h:type(), hafen.ui():role() and the menugrid's short id.
